title: Transitivity and summand preservation of rational purity
statement:
The purity isomorphisms of
[thm-pur-rational-and-qbar-purity] are transitive in coefficient
extensions, and preserve idempotent summands (via
[thm-weil-pbc-idempotent-complete-triangulation] and the descent
functors of [prop-weil-pbc-descent-functors]).

proof.text: Use the verbatim relocated scalar API, including ambient preservation, fraction naturality and the fixed raw-to-stage normalization. No construction or signature changes. The source-implied Noetherian, dimension and invertibility instances come from pbcPurityGeometricBounds of [def-pur-rational-purity-coefficient-models].
Use the original named StageA coherence obligation, now retained with the verbatim presentation definitions in RationalPurityPresentationData. No additional hole is introduced by this move.

Obtain the simultaneous normalized adjunctions from [lem-pur-pbc-finite-purity-adjunction]. Choose G to be the coherent twisted system itself, with these adjunctions, and gamma_E the identity. The exceptional specification is exactly the supplied counit square. Thus this is the twisted model of the actual right adjoint, pinned to the prescribed compact support; no free exceptional operation is supplied.

For transitivity the first identity is the symmetry of G.coh, with identity gamma components; the second identity is reflexivity. The finite-stage Karoubi transformation is the image of an identity under functorExtension₂, hence an isomorphism. For a retract i≫r=1, functoriality gives H(i)≫H(r)=1, for hom and inverse alike.

Use the exact-descent bridge for ExactDescent, then the proved identity-descent specialization for every formal descent clause. Its proof uses the StageSystem representative/component/extensionality/identity/composition laws and the published object formulas. The Qbar Karoubi clause is the component of the image of the identity natural isomorphism under functorExtension₂; the actual-retract clause follows from generic naturality followed by functoriality and i≫r=1, for hom and inverse.

proof_origin.place: Original Steps 1--7 and current rational-adjunction/coefficient-change proofs. A2 writes the complete final assembly in twisted right-adjoint coordinates, splits finite-stage normalized adjunction and exact descent, and leaves the original StageA coherence obligation unchanged.
